positive_snippets: Location: it's in a narrow road from main road, cabs won't come inside majority of time. But you can see the hotel sign board from main road. Rooms : They are small but very clean. So it size is no issue, this is good. Area is calm and quiet. The lightings are little dull. Kettle is provided. TV, cupboard and toilet kits are also provided. Service : Good staffs, good WiFi speed(~25mbps), free breakfast (from Oyo ).
negative_snippets: Pathetic and rude service, bed and rooms are full of cockroaches. The moment you just turn off the lights,cockroaches will start coming and running all over the bed and room. Ac is turned off during day time, geyser didn't work properly, had to call multiple times to reception to get it fixed. When I pointed out the cockroaches, the hotel management response was "it happens". Not worth for 1,100 rupees for 12 noon check out and Oyo was helpless when I pointed out the bad experience. Better stay away from this horrible place, there r much more better places in Pahargunj.
